responsibility: This definition module declares mc’s small printf-style output wrapper used throughout the toolchain. It offers stdout and file-specific formatted emission for up to four arguments and supports the compiler’s Name-based %a extension alongside ordinary numeric, character, and string formatting, giving other mc modules a uniform lightweight printing interface.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public declaration layer for mcPrintf’s lightweight formatted-output routines, exposing printf*/fprintf* entry points to other Modula-2 modules; mcPrintf.mod contains the actual %a translation and dispatch to FormatStrings and file output.
